applies_to: Swegon GOLD air handling units of generation E (RX, PX, CX and SD versions) running program version 1.10 or later.
summary: The built-in IQlogic controller in Swegon GOLD generation E air handlers is a native BACnet IP device (B-AAC profile) with no gateway needed. It publishes over 1,400 objects: fan airflow/pressure readings and setpoints, temperatures and regulation levels, heat-exchanger and coil data, accessory functions (Xzone, SMART Link, AYC, MIRU, COOL DX), one binary input per alarm, plus calendars, a schedule and notification classes for intrinsic alarming. The unit is started, stopped and speed-selected from the BMS through a single multistate value.
firmware: Program version 1.10 or later (driver in PV 1.16)
notes: Object tables are the same on every unit; points for accessories or heat-exchanger types not fitted read zero or inactive.
The Misc column in the source marks the program version (1.11-1.13) that added some objects.
Most alarms appear as individual BIs named 'Alarm <group>:<number> ...'; BI-13/14 summarize A- and B-class alarms.
Airflows are in l/s and temperatures in °C as published.
BI-104's object name is printed truncated in the source (a pressure-limit sentence) and is kept as printed.
BV-457 Dehumidifying function is marked as moved to MV-457.

source.title: BACnet IP GOLD RX/PX/CX/SD, Generation E

integration.summary: Command the unit with MV-793 Communication operation level (Auto lets the internal time channel run it; other states force stop, low or high speed) and read back MI-592 Operation level plus the low/high speed BIs. Adjust the main temperature setpoints (AV-132 supply, AV-135 extract/room) and airflow or pressure setpoints for low and high speed, and monitor BI-13/14 for A/B alarms with BV-1 to reset. The object summary on page 3 of the source lists these as the key points.

minimum_points.name: Operation level
minimum_points.why: Actual operating state and who stopped the unit

integration.enable: MV-793 Communication operation level: 1=Auto (unit follows its own time channel), 2=Total stop, 3=Low speed, 4=High speed, 5=Normal stop, 6=Extended normal stop. MI-592 shows whether a stop came from communication, the hand terminal, a digital input, the time channel or an alarm.
integration.remote_sensors: Room temperature can come from the BMS by enabling BV-167 'External room temp from BMS function' and writing AV-168; outdoor temperature likewise via BV-177 and AV-178. Each has an 'alarm time' AV in minutes (AV-169, AV-179; AV-179 defaults to 5). Xzone has its own BMS room temperature (BV-379, AV-380, AV-381).
setup: BACnet IP only; the device is a B-AAC with intrinsic alarming (notification classes NC-0, 1, 3, 10, 11).
Swegon also publishes a BACnet PICS and an EDE file for GOLD; device instance and IP settings are not given in this document.
gotchas: Calibration BVs (29-56) trigger pressure-sensor zero calibration.
Setpoints are split by low and high speed (e.g. AV-3/5 SA airflow, AV-19/21 SA duct pressure); write the one for the active speed.
Many objects only mean something when the related accessory or heat exchanger type (RX/PX/CX/SD) is installed.
Schedule #1 values are 1-5 (total stop to extended normal stop) with up to 6 time-values a day.
